title: JPMorgan projects Bitcoin to outperform US stocks and gold over next decade
summary: JPMorgan projects Bitcoin to outperform US stocks and gold over next decade
briefing: JPMorgan included Bitcoin in its long-term capital market outlook for the first time but warned that volatility and unstable correlations limit its role in investment portfolios.

title: BlackRock files for third Bitcoin ETF, still no Solana or XRP
summary: BlackRock files for third Bitcoin ETF, still no Solana or XRP
briefing: BlackRock’s proposed Bitcoin fund would use options to limit potential losses and gains, adding another strategy to its existing Bitcoin and Ether ETF lineup.

title: US Bitcoin ETFs draw $527M in biggest showing since September
summary: US Bitcoin ETFs draw $527M in biggest showing since September
briefing: BlackRock’s IBIT led the gains with $665.2 million in inflows, offsetting withdrawals from Fidelity and Grayscale, while other funds recorded no net flows.

title: Sophon sets Nov. 25 withdrawal deadline ahead of mainnet shutdown
summary: Sophon sets Nov. 25 withdrawal deadline ahead of mainnet shutdown
briefing: In June, Sophon’s developers said the costs of maintaining a standalone blockchain no longer justified its benefits and announced plans to focus on consumer finance and AI applications on Base.

title: US bans DeepSeek from civilian agency IT systems
summary: US bans DeepSeek from civilian agency IT systems
briefing: The restrictions extend earlier bans within US defense and security agencies, amid concerns that DeepSeek could expose federal information to China.

title: Bitcoin rally could revive treasury buying, but easy-money days over
summary: Bitcoin rally could revive treasury buying, but easy-money days over
briefing: “A return to last year’s indiscriminate capital raising looks unlikely,” said Bitfinex head of derivatives Jag Kooner.

title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI sells all SOL holdings, launches $201M buyback
summary: Solana treasury firm SkyAI sells all SOL holdings, launches $201M buyback
briefing: The former medical device maker has liquidated its Solana treasury and is offering to repurchase shares and warrants using its $223.8 million cash holdings.

title: Crypto PAC pours $362K into California race voters essentially decided in August
summary: Crypto PAC pours $362K into California race voters essentially decided in August
briefing: A Fairshake affiliate is supporting incumbent Aisha Wahab through ads in November, but the congresswoman already won a special election in the district.

title: Strive Buys $335 Million in Bitcoin After Investors Pour In $369 Million
summary: Strive Buys $335 Million in Bitcoin After Investors Pour In $369 Million
briefing: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin holder bought as warrant holders exercised, bringing in $369 million, and it now plans a $630 million sale of 15% preferred stock.

title: Anthropic Gives 5% of Itself to the Public. Musk Answers by Giving Away SpaceX Shares
summary: Anthropic Gives 5% of Itself to the Public. Musk Answers by Giving Away SpaceX Shares
briefing: Anthropic committed 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, and within hours Elon Musk promised a SpaceX share to every American child.

title: XRP Ledger Repairs Its Lending Protocol Before It Goes Live
summary: XRP Ledger Repairs Its Lending Protocol Before It Goes Live
briefing: XRP developers published a second amendment to repair the ledger’s new uncollateralized lending feature while the original still awaits validator approval.

title: Hackers Are Running Apple's iOS on Android Phones for the First Time
summary: Hackers Are Running Apple's iOS on Android Phones for the First Time
briefing: Hobbyists are booting iOS 16 on Xiaomi and Nothing phones and posting the proof. It barely works, but it suggests Apple's software is no longer welded to Apple's hardware.

title: Mastercard Brings Its Fraud-Fighting Tools to Stablecoin Payments
summary: Mastercard Brings Its Fraud-Fighting Tools to Stablecoin Payments
briefing: Unveiled at Money20/20, the API-based tool combines payment and blockchain intelligence to flag fraud, scams and sanctions exposure before funds move on-chain.

title: Why Some of America’s Biggest Companies Are Objecting to Tokenized Shares
summary: Why Some of America’s Biggest Companies Are Objecting to Tokenized Shares
briefing: Nine companies, including Verizon, Broadcom and UnitedHealth, have objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue.

title: US Orders Civilian Agencies to Rip DeepSeek Out of Government Systems
summary: US Orders Civilian Agencies to Rip DeepSeek Out of Government Systems
briefing: The Department of Homeland Security told civilian agencies to remove China's DeepSeek and any service built on it, and banned buying more, citing the risk of sensitive data reaching Beijing.

title: JPMorgan's JPM Coin Arrives on Ethereum, Putting Bank Dollars on a Public Blockchain
summary: JPMorgan's JPM Coin Arrives on Ethereum, Putting Bank Dollars on a Public Blockchain
briefing: JPMorgan is rolling out JPM Coin on Ethereum for institutional clients, a token backed by dollars in its accounts that settles in seconds, any day of the week.
